_about: Draft gold labels for the W3 site profile, prompt v3 definitions (enquiry_form, wins_by_tender), written by Claude Opus 5.5 in the Claude Code chat of 2026-10-04 from the same inputs the model sees (site text, principal activity, Maps category), for a seeded random draw of 61 companies (evals/website_profile_gold_set/selection-2026-10-04.json). No model has been run on these companies. Not ground truth until reviewed in Langfuse. Phrases follow the phrase rule in docs/WEB_STAGE_PLAN.md.
